goal: A pure-Python controller consistently owns all required workspace states, application-service orchestration, action guards, and stale-result suppression before Qt widgets are introduced.
non_goals: Do not import PySide6 or create Qt widgets, windows, runners, dialogs, or entrypoints.
Do not implement source file reads, writes, Save, Save As, atomic source replacement, or permission probes.
Do not add build_service cancellation predicates or claim UI token invalidation interrupts renderer execution.
Do not implement diagnostics localization, template UI, outline, or preview mapping.
Do not change parser, validator, compiler, renderer, or application service behavior.
expected_evidence: Observed strict-TDD RED for missing controller/view-model APIs
Headless tests covering immutable models and every required workspace state
Tests covering dirty/repeated-action guards, stale progress/success/failure suppression, newer-generation wins, and recovery
Architecture tests proving controller/view-model modules have no PySide6, python-docx, or lxml imports
Focused and full pytest, Ruff, pip check, strict OpenSpec, SpecNav entry, CodeGraph, and whitespace evidence
Task report, independent spec review, and independent quality review
unsafe_assumptions: Task runner callbacks arrive in order or synchronously.
Dirty editor text is equivalent to a saved source snapshot.
Controller cancellation interrupts application work rather than only invalidating callbacks.
Permission failures can be presented as generic errors.
A stale build result may update the current output path.
A filesystem seam must perform source I/O before Slice 003.
stop_condition: Stop if implementation would edit outside the six allowed source/test files, duplicate application pipeline logic, perform source I/O, change application cancellation behavior, or import Qt/DOCX/XML implementation modules.
